# Test fixtures

Small, hand-written input files. Each file triggers one scenario or error code listed in
[docs/ERROR_CATALOG.md](../../docs/ERROR_CATALOG.md). All data is synthetic.

Demo-only inputs (used by `demo/run_demo_record.py`, not by tests): `lab_c_first_delivery.csv` (Lab C's
first delivery, 50 rows), `lab_c_aliases.csv` and `lab_c_registry.csv` (the reference-data and registry
lines that onboard Lab C), and `contracts/lab_c_v1.yaml`.
